name: ako-multilang
description: Link your pages across languages with hreflang, right-to-left support, and a language switcher. Your URLs stay the same.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build admin/index=./src/admin/index.js editor/index=./src/editor/index.js classic/index=./src/classic/index.js block/index=./src/block/index.js --output-path=build
scripts.start: wp-scripts start admin/index=./src/admin/index.js editor/index=./src/editor/index.js classic/index=./src/classic/index.js block/index=./src/block/index.js --output-path=build
